name: OpenAgriNet API local (single and multi mode)

values.description: Consumer entry point: discover, select, init, status, support and the health check. Single mode (default): http://127.0.0.1:9201/consumer, NETWORK_ADAPTER_PORT in .env. Multi mode: http://127.0.0.1:9202/consumer, CONSUMER_ADAPTER_PORT in .env.
The catalogue index. Reached through an adapter, not directly, so only its health check is here. DISCOVERY_PORT in .env.
Participants and capability bindings, seeded by bin/setup.py. HOST ONLY: the API base is /api/v1, so a request spells it out. REGISTRY_PORT in .env.

Provider entry point for every catalog/publish. Single mode (default): http://127.0.0.1:9201/publish, NETWORK_ADAPTER_PORT in .env. Multi mode: http://127.0.0.1:9200/publish, PROVIDER_ADAPTER_PORT in .env.
